items.title: CME Group (CME) Unveils European Dairy Futures
items.summary: CME Group (NasdaqGS:CME) introduced a new suite of European dairy futures, marking its first major move into regional agri derivatives. The contracts expand CME Group's existing dairy offering for Europe, building on its partnership with the European Energy Exchange. European producers, processors and traders gain a regulated futures venue designed to help manage milk and dairy price risk on a single platform. items.summary: CME Group (CME) is back in focus after reporting a new single-day record of 71.5 million contracts traded on 23 November, driven by heavy interest rate and equity activity. Recent product launches and record trading sessions have landed alongside a solid run in the shares, with CME Group’s 90-day share price return of 10.96% feeding into a 15.6% year to date gain and a 5-year total shareholder return of 74.81%.
